transforms.name: reduplication
transforms.description: Full reduplication: the word said twice (xanh xanh → xanh, người người → người). It softens an adjective (bluish), repeats a verb or makes a noun mean "every". Also the last word of a phrase (trắng phau phau → trắng phau).

transforms.name: partial reduplication
transforms.description: The word said twice, the first time with a level tone (sắc and hỏi lose their mark, nặng becomes huyền, ngã either) and a final p, t, c or ch made m, n, ng or nh: đo đỏ → đỏ, nhè nhẹ → nhẹ, man mát → mát, sành sạch → sạch. It usually softens an adjective (reddish, a little light); some forms intensify it (vun vút → vút). Also after a word (đỏ chon chót → đỏ chót).

transforms.name: AABB reduplication
transforms.description: Each word of a two-word expression said twice: đi đi lại lại → đi lại (going back and forth again and again), vội vội vàng vàng → vội vàng.

transforms.name: four-syllable reduplication
transforms.description: A two-word expression with its first word repeated after a syllable in -a: lôi tha lôi thôi → lôi thôi, lẩm bà lẩm bẩm → lẩm bẩm. It stresses how long or how often something goes on.
